source:
@@U04619@@
(Solo.)

@@U04620@@
Who has built this house so vilely, With shovel, pick, and spade?

@@U04622@@
For you, dull guest, in hempen vest, This house was too well made.

@@U04624@@
(Solo.)

@@U04625@@
Who was it decked the hall so badly? Chairs, tables, are there any?

@@U04627@@
It was loaned, not to be owned; The creditors are many.

@@U04629@@
There lies the corpse. If it tries to flee I'll simply whip out the blood-signed document. Ah, but you never know. There are many ways of outwitting the Devil. They'd steal a soul right from under my nose. Our old ways are passé, the new ones haven't caught on yet; besides, in the old days I'd have done this solo, today I need accomplices. This isn’t the best of times for devils. Tradition, custom, ancient privileges, gone with the wind! What can you trust these days? Time was, when a man breathed his last, swoosh! out slipped the soul like a mouse on the run, and I like any old self-respecting feline
translation:
@@U04619@@
（独奏。）

@@U04620@@
是谁用铲子、镐和铁锹，把这座房子建得如此卑鄙？

@@U04622@@
对你这个穿着麻背心的迟钝客人来说，这房子做得太精良了。

@@U04624@@
（独奏。）

@@U04625@@
是谁把大厅布置得这么糟糕？椅子，桌子，有吗？

@@U04627@@
它是借来的，不是用来拥有的；债权人很多。

@@U04629@@
那儿躺着尸体。如果它试图逃跑，我就会拿出那份血迹斑斑的文件。啊，但你永远不知道。智胜魔鬼的方法有很多种。他们会在我眼皮子底下偷走一个灵魂。我们的旧方式已经过时，新方式还没有流行；此外，在过去我会独自完成这件事，今天我需要合作伙伴。对于魔鬼来说，这不是最好的时代。传统、习俗、古老的特权，都随风而逝！如今你能相信什么？时间就是，当一个人咽下最后一口气的时候，嗖嗖！灵魂像逃跑的老鼠一样溜走了，我喜欢任何有自尊心的老猫
